g.text: Average input utility improves, but the four-gate criterion is not met
Fixed hg38 chr16/18 panel · 726 reference locus units · 20 cores × 3 arms · 60 completed cells.
P−U is prespecified: Δ = +0.0631, 95% CI [+0.0365, +0.1068]; P−R CI crosses 0.
No equivalence or P-over-R superiority claim. Exploratory fixed-panel input utility, not independent generalization or no-risk evidence.
